svg.text: Same task, same agent: Jev routing on vs. off
Bars are medians, dots are the individual runs (5 per mode), drawn relative to each pair's baseline median.
Lower is better, except for checks passed. Codex: gpt-6-astra, Claude Code: claude-fable-5-1.
